s.note: they bring out the flavour of the champagne
s.how: Wash and properly dry 500g of the ripest strawberries and chill. Pile them into a glass bowl with a tiny dish of caster sugar for dipping. Open a very cold bottle of sparkling wine alongside.

s.note: the snail that flies across the restaurant
s.how: Put 20 button mushroom caps or escargot in a baking dish. Mash 100g butter with 3 garlic cloves, parsley, a chopped shallot and a splash of brandy and cover each one. Bake at 200C for 10 minutes until sizzling. Serve with baguette.

m.note: the dinner where she learns which fork to use
m.how: Slice 1kg potatoes thin, layer with 300ml cream and garlic and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Sear an 800g eye fillet and roast at 200C to 54C, then rest. Reduce shallots with 250ml red wine and 300ml stock for jus. Steam 300g green beans.

w.note: dessert after the night at the opera
w.how: Wash and completely dry 500g strawberries. Dip each in 200g melted dark chocolate and set on baking paper. Drizzle thin lines of 50g melted white chocolate across them and chill until set.

d.how: Chill a 750ml bottle of champagne in an ice bucket with ice and water for 30 minutes. Open gently and pour into four flutes. Big mistake not to. Huge.
